title: IntentGuard — A compromised agent. A payment boundary that holds.
evidence: Recorded NEAR Sandbox transactions; deterministic adversarial cases. The public console sends no new transactions.

scenes.title: What if your agent pays the wrong person?
scenes.narration: What happens when an AI agent pays the wrong person? Intent Guard puts the payment boundary on NEAR.

scenes.title: Start with Replay attack demo
scenes.narration: Click Replay attack demo to begin. This public console replays real NEAR Sandbox receipts. It sends no new transaction.

scenes.title: 01 · The unrestricted wallet pays the attacker
scenes.narration: Select Unprotected wallet. With full access, the malicious request pays the attacker zero point zero eight NEAR.

scenes.title: 02 · IntentGuard blocks the redirected payment
scenes.narration: Now select Redirected request. Intent Guard rejects the changed recipient because the owner approved a different vendor. The attacker gets zero.

scenes.title: 03 · The approved vendor gets paid
scenes.narration: Select Approved invoice. The original vendor receives exactly zero point zero eight NEAR. That invoice can only be paid once.

scenes.title: Try Protocol → Skip the firewall
scenes.narration: To inspect a bypass, choose Protocol, then Skip the firewall. Click Inspect selected receipt. NEAR rejects the raw transfer before inclusion.

scenes.title: Inspect the key, limits, and rejection
scenes.narration: Open Agent policy in the sidebar. Here are the restricted key, payment limit, and daily budget. Expand receipt logs to inspect the rejection.

scenes.title: Search a case. Inspect its original receipt.
scenes.narration: Back in Attack console, search for replay. Select the case and inspect its receipt. A paid invoice cannot release funds again.

scenes.title: Explore all 22 verified cases
scenes.narration: Choose Explore all twenty two cases. Results and receipts lets you revisit every outcome, with original timestamps and transaction evidence.

scenes.title: Download the complete evidence bundle
scenes.narration: Click Download proof for the complete evidence bundle. Nineteen adversarial cases were blocked, alongside the control, approved payment, and failed transfer recovery.

scenes.title: The owner approves. NEAR enforces.
scenes.narration: The agent makes the request. NEAR enforces the owner's approval. Intent Guard. Built at NEAR Hackathon. Try the demo and inspect the proof.
